name: Airoha Technology Corp
summary: Airoha Technology Corp. is a Taiwanese enterprise that focuses on developing sophisticated system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for the wireless and high-speed networking industries. Their extensive product line features integrated circuits for Bluetooth wireless audio, global navigation satellite systems (GNSS), and complete, ready-to-implement solutions for xVDSL and xPON gateways/routers. Furthermore, the company supplies Ethernet switch SoCs and other relevant integrated circuit components. Founded in 2002, Airoha Technology's primary operational base is located in Zhubei, Taiwan.
